source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 returns an exactly feasible rounded plan with additive original-OT objective error; Remark 1 says its complexity initially counts arithmetic operations and gives a bit-complexity remark; Lemma 7 controls the exact rounding displacement.

The proceedings analyze a fixed-point format and prove approximate relative-entropy scaling with bounded scalings and a probabilistic quantum algorithm. The published result is Theorem 4; it contains no Theorem 4.7.

The paper characterizes the sharp set by D_0, defines the directional entropic criterion c_{theta,epsilon} and D_epsilon, and proves a uniform CLT for the regularized directional OT value; it does not state the proposed positive-temperature zero-set characterization.

The paper characterizes convergent concave annealing schedules, separates entropic and relaxation errors along the regularization path, and gives an asymptotic debiasing proposition rather than an outward finite-precision original-value certificate.
